name: Gemini API
description: Serves Google's Gemini models through the Gemini Developer API and Gen AI SDKs, with function calling, structured output, Live API voice, and image generation, for developers.

skills.name: Function Calling
skills.description: Lets Gemini models call functions you declare and return structured arguments for your code to run.

skills.name: Structured Output
skills.description: Constrains Gemini responses to JSON that matches a supplied schema for automated processing.

skills.name: Live API
skills.description: Builds real-time voice applications and agents over a low-latency streaming connection.

skills.name: Image Generation
skills.description: Generates and edits images with Gemini image models from text and image prompts.

skills.name: Embeddings
skills.description: Converts text into embedding vectors for search, clustering, and classification.
